name: com.alexgofman.iap5-purchase-guard
description: Client-side purchase hardening for Unity IAP 5: a four-verdict receipt gate with a stated fail-open or fail-closed policy, a persisted transaction ledger so a redelivered order is confirmed again instead of granted again, a fixed order of operations (dedupe, trust gate, grant, confirm), explicit store naming, refund detection by owned-set diff, and install-source detection.

samples.description: A three-product catalogue, entitlements kept in PlayerPrefs, and an IMGUI screen that buys and restores.
